thread:
mika (CS): ParcelX reporting intermittent 403s during onboarding. Happens only when their traffic passes their new edge proxy. Renewal review in two weeks; flagging as high touch.

leo (eng): Can you get a minimal repro and the raw response body? 403s could be auth header dropped after a redirect or client-side key mismatch.

mika (CS): Repro they gave: Lambda using Node SDK. First few warm requests 200 then some hits 403. One example payload: {"error":"unauthorized","info":"Authorization header missing after redirect"}.

yasmin (support): Node SDK uses node-fetch with redirect:'follow' by default. Many HTTP clients omit Authorization when following a 3xx to a different host. If their edge returns 307 to regional host, header gets stripped.

leo (eng): Quick check for them: run `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer X" https://their-edge/` and observe whether the edge forwards the header to the Location target.

mika (CS): ParcelX ran curl and confirmed header not forwarded on follow. Ops applied a quick nginx tweak in staging: `proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;`

yasmin (support): Temporary SDK option: set env `REDWOOD_HTTP_REDIRECT=manual` so the SDK surfaces 3xx and client can re-request the Location with Authorization intact. Added to troubleshooting doc.

leo (eng): I'll open a small Node SDK change to re-attach Authorization on cross-host redirects and add a test for 307 flows. PR will be small.

parcelx-onboard-bot: [2026-03-01T02:10:00Z] staging: 1800s no 403s after proxy change

mika (CS): ParcelX to deploy to prod tonight; renewal decision paused one week. Account health note: "Edge proxy was issuing 307; auth header dropped on client redirect. Staging fixed via nginx proxy header forwarding; SDK patch pending PR. Monitor prod rollout." :thumbsup:
